//: EconomyX skin. Paints the dark panel and grey border behind EconomyX's own forms and leaves every other form in the game alone.
//_targeting: Every EconomyX form title starts with the marker '§8§r' (UI_TAG in scripts/main.js) — a colour code followed straight away by a reset, so it renders as nothing but is still readable by the #title_text binding. ex_skin_on is true only for those forms.
//_safety: Both layers are declared visible:false and are only switched on by the binding below. If the binding ever fails to resolve on a future Bedrock version, the layers stay off and every form falls back to stock appearance — the skin can fail quiet, but it cannot paint over a form or swallow its buttons. Nothing here redefines vanilla's title, body, button factory or close button; the layers are inserted behind them with the 'modifications' operation, so the machinery that drives the forms is untouched.
//_phone: The phone screen is a FORM, not a HUD overlay: Bedrock cannot open a custom clickable JSON-UI screen from a script, and the form system is the only UI a script can both open and read a press back from. scripts/phones.js prefixes that form's title with PHONE_UI_TAG ('§d§r§0§r'), and this layer paints the handset's front behind it. That marker deliberately does not contain '§8§r', so a phone screen never gets the bank panel painted behind it as well.
